text: My tag is on the hanger. Will you take it to their console and read it in? Out loud. So it says Pohl. Not bay six.
Get up. Please get up. They'll put you on a hanger.
They're coming down the aisles again. I'll keep still. Mind the racks.
Pohl. Obergefreiter Pohl, wireless operator, the Kranich. They hung me up with the others, and I... didn't go to sleep.
Riedl and Haas are in the next bays. Don't try to wake them. I tried. I don't think they can be woken.
I kept the set warm the whole way up. Nobody answered. Only the voice, and it only ever said thank you.
Pohl. That's right. That's my name. ...Thank you.
